# End-to-End Pipeline Case Study {#sec-end-to-end-case-study}

## Learning objectives

- Assemble extraction, validation, transformation, and loading stages.
- Verify outputs and operational metadata.
- Evaluate the pipeline against reliability and governance requirements.

## Starter execution

```bash
bash scripts/bash/00-check-environment.sh
bash scripts/bash/07-run-starter-pipeline.sh
python -m pytest -q
```
